rows.abstract: Aims to a.) Establish a Special fund that shall be disbursed primarily for the implementation of infrastructure projects across four (4) priority areas - Health, Education, Agriculture, and Local Roads/Infrastructure and Livelihood (HEAL); b.)Define the guidelines, criteria, and standards in accessing, implementation, and evaluation of use of the same fund; and c.) rows.title_full: AN ACT ENABLING BANKS TO EXPAND SERVICE DELIVERY CHANNELS THROUGH CASH AGENTS AND PROVIDING GUIDELINES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: " Bangko Sa Baryo Act "
rows.abstract:
Seeks to create an enabling regulatory environment for innovations and allow banks to exponentially expand reach through cash agents and serve clients, particularly in the low-income and rural areas, more efficiently.

Allows banks, with prior BSP authorization, to serve clients through cash agents to accept and disburse cash on the bank´s behalf, collect and forward applications for opening a savings account, forward loan application documents, perform initial Customer Identity Verification, and bills payments.
Provides incentives to any persons who shall establish its business in remote areas such as waiver of government fees, free personnel training, tax benefits, among other.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-08-11, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-08-13 and received by the Senate on 2020-08-19

rows.author: I083
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE E-GOVERNMENT, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: " E- Government Act "
rows.abstract:
Aims to develop a framework to guide and govern basic technical interoperability of government ICT systems between and among its various agencies in dealing with their constituencies.
Mandates the Secretary of the DICT to head the E-Government initiative and to spearhead all aspects of implementation of the E-Government Master Plan for the optimum use of ICT in government to expand and improve public services, government operations and capabilities.
Authorizes the appointment of an ICT officer for each Local Government Unit who shall manage and supervise the adoption of the E-Government Plan and to spearhead seminars and other means of educating the community to maximize E-Government initiatives.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-08-11, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-08-13 and received by the Senate on 2020-08-19

rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING PARENTS TO PLANT TWO  (2) TREES FOR EVERY CHILD BORN TO THEM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: " Family Tree Planting Act "
rows.abstract:
Aims to promote and pursue reforestation programs and encourage tree planting as part of the family´s responsibility and legacy to protect the environment and conserve natural resources for the future generation.
Mandates Local Civil Registry where the birth of the child shall be registered, to release the Certificate of Live Birth of the child upon presentation of the parent´s sworn statement of compliance sworn to before the Punong Barangay of the premises where the trees were planted, or before the DENR officer concerned if the trees were planted in a government-designated area outside the barangay where the family resides.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-08-26, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-09-01 and received by the Senate on 2020-09-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING ENVIRONMENTAL TAXATION FOR THE PROTECTION OF PHILIPPINE NATURAL RESOURCES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to impose environmental taxes (green taxes) on all kinds of pollutants with natural resources such as air, water, biodiversity, energy, land, and other environmental conservation.

Proposes several taxes as follows:  registration taxes on new and second-hand vehicles and congestion tax on heavy-traffic roads identified by the Metro Manila Dev´t Authority (MMDA); taxes on transport and heating fuels; air pollution tax from stationary sources emitting excessive carbon dioxide and ticket tax on the carriage of passengers on board fixed-wing and rotary-wing aircraft; taxes on water resources extraction, water supply, and wastewater; taxes on biodiversity services such as conservation tax, fishery management tax, and non-compliance tax; taxes on waste management such as landfill, incineration, and pay-as-you-throw schemes; taxes on the exploration of natural resources such as signature bonus tax and aggregate tax; and taxes on the use of chemicals in agriculture.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2020-06-03

rows.author: I003
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GREEN PUBLIC PROCUREMENT PROGRAM FOR ALL BRANCHES OF GOVERNMENT
rows.title_short: Green Public Procurement Act
rows.abstract:
Establishes a Green Public Procurement (GPP) Program in the executive, judicial and legislative branches of government to achieve sustainable consumption and production in government procurement in accordance with the GPP Roadmap established by the Government Procurement Policy Board (GPPB) for the purpose, consistent with the governing principles of RA No. 9184, or the Procurement Reform Act.

Mandates the GPPB to design and conduct capability-building programs for all concerned procuring entities as well as green products suppliers 

Mandates the verification of the compliance of goods or items being procured with the green criteria established by the GPPB, in accordance with the provisions under RA 9184.
